snippet.title: Sift Heads Rush - A Cartel's End | Trailer
snippet.description:
∎ Get   SIFT HEADS - RUSH   now ! : https://siftheads.net/siftheads-rush
∎ Also available on Steam on August 1st. Steam page : https://bit.ly/3xVaLOh

[Game Description]
Not just anyone can stand up to such powerful and established criminal organizations. Vinnie is the only real opposition, persistent and solid. Join him and dive into this bottomless sea of blood where violence and greed control everything! For the first time, we discover Chicago in a much more interactive way, with a ton of locations and enemies more dangerous than ever. It will take special tactics and equipment to overcome it. A street war is on the horizon and no one is safe. Vinnie can only count on his 2 sidekicks, Shorty & Kiro to succeed. This is an arduous task that awaits them. The end is coming...

• Become a headhunter
• Faced the plague
• Obtain powerful weapons
• 12 huge areas to explore
• Aquire specialized skillsreveal hidden secrets
• Be merciless

[Boss Battles]
Face brutal bumps where every mistake could be the end!

[Side Contracts]
Organized crime has done a lot of collateral damage, help who you can.

[Hours Of Fun]
Get lost in the Sift Heads Universe. And if it's not enough, you will be served with the upcoming New Game + mode.

[Action packed gameplay]
This time, a real challenge awaits with devastating opponents! Adapt your tactics to the environment and forces against you.

[Powerful skills]
Customize and improve your own preferred skill set. Find unique weapons to customize and unleash devastating attacks.

[Unique cinematic style]
Deep and captivating story, charismatic characters and lore to uncover.

Message from the developer:
Thanks to all the fans for being patient! As many people know, I'm the only one working on the game and it takes a lot of time. The Sift Heads series couldn't produce anything for a few years for several reasons and that's why I wanted to take my time to come back strong. If you've noticed, Sift Heads Rush is a product that is different in a positive way. This one has matured, grown and is certainly the most refined of the series. While a Sift Heads could give you thirty minutes, this one will keep you going for hours. This is why, this time, the game is paying off. Also due to the fact that the game has no advertising. We have no choice but to sell it to be fair with all the effort put into this new title. Honestly, I have never worked so hard on a project. I put all my love into it. I hope you enjoyed it.

 - Chriss
